sloka: वचनात् एव ताः तस्य विकृता घोर दर्शनाः ।कृत प्रांजलयो भूत्वा मैथिलीम् पर्यवारयन् ॥३-५६-२८॥
transliteration: vacanāt eva tāḥ tasya vikṛtā ghora darśanāḥ ।kṛta prāṁjalayo bhūtvā maithilīm paryavārayan ॥3-56-28॥

translations.english: No sooner had Ravana said it than the dreadful demonesses offered obeisance to him with folded hands and surrounded Sita.
